rubric.role_summary: Physical design engineer for inference-focused ASIC hardware, owning block-level implementation, verification, timing closure, and PPA optimization while improving design flows and overseeing third-party design work.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Physical design engineer for inference-focused ASIC hardware, owning block-level implementation, verification, timing closure, and PPA optimization while improving design flows and overseeing third-party design work.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of previous physical design experience.
- Knowledge of tools, flows, and design methodology from RTL synthesis to GDSII sign-off.
- Back-end physical design and timing closure experience.
- Experience with Cadence (Innovus, Genus) or Synopsys (ICC2, Fusion Compiler) automated RTL-to-GDSII flows.
- Experience with sign-off tools, such as PrimeTime, Tempus, or Voltus.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with modern ML and LLM model architectures.
- Ability to program with Python or another scripting language.
- Familiarity with AI tools for programming or coding.
- Startup experience.
- Back-end design and timing closure experience on advanced process nodes of 5nm and below.
- Experience with the listed low-power design, power verification, synthesis, scan insertion/ATPG, formal verification, physical implementation, and IR drop and EM/antenna analysis methodologies.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: United States. The role is onsite in San Jose, California, and relocation is provided, so candidates anywhere in the United States qualify; current residence near the office is not required. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
